h_wording.H304: May be fatal if swallowed and enters airways

structure_display.line: Drawn with the magnesium bonded to the four ring nitrogens in the middle of the ring; PubChem's one-line structure leaves the magnesium apart.

why_it_matters.text: The green of every leaf, and the molecule that catches sunlight and starts photosynthesis. Its magnesium atom sits where iron sits in haemoglobin.

description: The green of every leaf, and the molecule that catches sunlight and starts photosynthesis. Its magnesium atom sits where iron sits in haemoglobin.

parts.label: The ester group
parts.sentence: A C=O joined through an oxygen to another carbon, the link an acid and an alcohol make when they combine. Water can split it back into the two.

parts.label: The ketone group
parts.sentence: A C=O with a carbon on each side. Its oxygen accepts hydrogen bonds but has no hydrogen to give, and it resists oxidation better than an aldehyde.

parts.label: The ring system
parts.sentence: Rings joined where they share atoms, or a single ring standing alone. Atoms in a ring are held in place, so this part keeps its shape while chains around it can bend.
